notes.title: Snow Girl Legend Children's Day Version Update Instructions
notes.content:

3. Add a new area called "Back Mountain Forbidden Area" where Snow Maiden can enter after joining the team. If it is difficult to complete the "Senior Sister Snow Maiden Trial" at the current level, come here to practice your level
